title: Trump Furnished Residences - DarGlobal
text: TRUMP FURNISHED RESIDENCES. MUSCAT | OMAN. Indulge in luxury living at the Trump Furnished Residences in Aida. Each residence is curated to exceed the highest standards of comfort and style. From stunning interiors to breathtaking views, every detail, down to the last sugar spoon has been thoughtfully designed to elevate your lifestyle. Managed by Trump, these furnished residences offer the option to live in them or rent them out, with the assurance of exceptional quality and service synonymous with the Trump brand. KEY FEATURES: In addition to stunning views, luxurious amenities, and an array of activities to enjoy, the Trump Furnished residences at AIDA is in close proximity to 5-star landmark destinations including, the Ritz Carlton, The Shangri-La Resort, Nikki Beach, and The Jumeirah Hotels. Championship Golf Course. The Members Only Club. The Hanging Suites. The Hanging Club. AIDA Beach. AMENITIES: Trump International Golf Club, Oman; Community & Retail Centre; Plazas, Cafes & Restaurants; Wellness Centres; Fitness Center; Promenades; Hiking Trail; Mountain Bike; Luxury Hotels; Outdoor Landscapes; Running Trail; Viewing Deck. WHY INVEST (as stated by DarGlobal): Life-time Residency Visa for investors on projects in the ITC; upcoming railway project connecting UAE to Muscat, Oman; 100% Freehold Ownership for all nationalities*; 0% Personal Income tax; 0% Capital Gains tax; 0% Inheritance tax (Oman applies the inheritance laws of the investor's country of origin, not local laws); 25 years exemption from corporate income taxes for special economic/free zone. LOCATION: The Trump Furnished Villas are exclusively available in Aida, a supreme gated community and golfing destination. It is nestled in a lush oasis of tranquility, located only 25 minutes from the vibrant heart of Muscat and its airport. AIDA - Trump Furnished Residences, Muscat, Oman.
